title: Assessing Boron-Pleuromutilin AN11251 for the Development of Antibacterial Agents
quote: The human systemic clearance was estimated through the simple allometric scaling using rat PK systemic clearance.

verified_quotes.text: The human systemic clearance was estimated through the simple allometric scaling using rat PK systemic clearance.

summary: Rat IV/PO mean-profile NCA feeds scaled human CL and volume, then a one-compartment exposure simulation. Oral absorption and bioavailability require explicit assumptions.
validation: No independent human PK validation established here. Source dose/unit wording and total-versus-free target consistency need checking; do not copy its doses or empirical factors as PMB rules.
data_availability: Open figures and summary tables; individual concentration data not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
